clauses.quote: The Board and a teacher may mutually agree to terminate the teacher's contract at any time.

A teacher may retire from employment at the end of the first semester in January by submitting written notice to Human Resources no later than October 1 or may retire on the last day of the school year by submitting written notice to Human Resources no later than February 1.
A teacher may terminate their contract upon thirty days written notice to the director of Human Resources.
Liquidated damages in the amount of $1,000 will be levied against a teacher who fails to give the above required notice.
clauses.subject_text: Liquidated damages in the amount of $1,000
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management duty to impose penalty.

clauses.quote: All teachers under contract shall be eligible for the group insurance programs provided by the board.
Teachers who complete the online insurance enrollment within their first 30 days of contract employment will have insurance for individual selected coverage.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who complete the online insurance enrollment within their first 30 days of contract employment

clauses.quote: Teachers must elect to receive or waive insurance coverage annually.

Teachers who enroll in voluntary life insurance, increase voluntary life insurance or disability coverage after their first 30 days of contract employment must complete an evidence of insurability form.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who enroll in voluntary life insurance, increase voluntary life insurance or disability coverage after their first 30 days of contract employment

clauses.quote: The evidence of insurability form must be approved by the carrier before coverage is effective.
Any life changing events affecting insurance coverage (marriage, divorce, death, birth, etc.) must be reported to the Benefits Office within 30 calendar days of the event to ensure coverage.
clauses.subject_text: Any life changing events affecting insurance coverage (marriage, divorce, death, birth, etc.)
clauses.notes: Passive construction imposing duty on teacher.
